records.title: Unleashing the Emergent Cognitive Synergy in Large Language Models: A Task-Solving Agent through Multi-Persona Self-Collaboration
records.reason: 単一LLMに複数personaを動的に演じさせてmulti-turn self-collaborationを行い、複雑taskのproblem-solving能力とhallucinationを改善するprompting/agent capability研究。主要評価はTrivia Creative Writing、Codenames、Logic Grid Puzzleのtask performanceで、agentic inference runtime・scheduling・memory・serving効率化を提案しない。
records.body_check: abstract_screen_only: 一次arXiv要旨でSolo Performance Prompting、dynamic multi-persona self-collaboration、3 taskでのproblem-solving/hallucination評価が主題と確認。推論system対象外のため本文未読。
